phase: incomplete: SMTP_URL set, SMTP_FROM empty (overlay-mail-incomplete.json); OIDC fixture running

steps.action: Create the first Administrator step 1: open the instance address on a fresh instance
steps.expected: Set up OpenLaw shows Setup token, Name, Email, Password, Confirm password and Create Administrator
steps.actual: / redirected to /auth/setup, which showed Set up OpenLaw with Setup token, Name, Email, Password, Confirm password and Create Administrator.

steps.action: Before you start: open OpenLaw from another address (localhost instead of the instance address 127.0.0.1) and submit the setup form
steps.expected: OpenLaw refuses to save and shows "This request did not come from this OpenLaw instance's own origin."
steps.actual: At http://localhost:43385/auth/setup, Create Administrator showed "This request did not come from this OpenLaw instance's own origin." and needsSetup stayed true.

steps.action: Step 3: leave Setup token empty and select Create Administrator
steps.expected: An empty required field stops the form before it is sent; no account is created
steps.actual: The browser stopped the form with "Please fill out this field." on Setup token. No POST /api/v1/auth/setup was sent and needsSetup stayed true.

steps.action: Step 3: an email address that is not valid
steps.expected: "Enter a valid email address."; the form is not sent
steps.actual: With Email "avery.morgan@harbor", Create Administrator was stopped with the field message "Enter a valid email address." and no request was sent.

steps.action: Step 2 and 3: a password shorter than eight characters
steps.expected: "Passwords must be 8 characters or more."; the form is not sent
steps.actual: A seven-character password in both fields was stopped with the field message "Passwords must be 8 characters or more." and no request was sent.

steps.action: Step 3: when OpenLaw accepts the token, a green check mark appears in the field and a screen reader announces Setup token verified; a wrong token shows the token message
steps.expected: A visible green check mark and the accessible description "Setup token verified" for the correct token; neither for a wrong one; "The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy it from the server log, or from the SETUP_TOKEN environment variable."
steps.actual: The correct token showed a check mark (16 x 16 px, rgb(26, 127, 55), class "pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-2.5 flex items-center text-status-success-fg") inside the Setup token box and gave the box the accessible description "Setup token verified" (screenshot fr-setup-token-verified.png, token text hidden). A wrong token showed no check mark and no description, and Create Administrator showed "The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy it from the server log, or from the SETUP_TOKEN environment variable.".

steps.action: Step 3: a wrong setup token is refused with the token message
steps.expected: "The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy it from the server log, or from the SETUP_TOKEN environment variable."; no account
steps.actual: The page showed "The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy it from the server log, or from the SETUP_TOKEN environment variable." and needsSetup stayed true.

steps.action: Step 3: different values in Password and Confirm password
steps.expected: "The passwords do not match."; no account
steps.actual: The page showed "The passwords do not match." and needsSetup stayed true.

steps.action: Step 3: the form keeps your entries in this browser tab if you reload, until setup succeeds
steps.expected: After reload the fields hold the same values; a new tab starts empty
steps.actual: After reload the same tab held {"token":true,"name":"Avery Morgan","email":"avery.morgan@harbor.example","password":true,"confirm":true} (token and passwords compared, not recorded). A new tab in the same browser started with {"token":false,"name":"","email":"","password":false,"confirm":false}.

steps.action: Step 3: correct the entries and select Create Administrator
steps.expected: A successful setup signs you in and opens Welcome to OpenLaw (Step 1 of 8)
steps.actual: Signed in as Avery Morgan (administrator) at /welcome. Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw. The step shows Get started and Skip optional steps, and no Set up later.

steps.action: Account setup is available only while the instance has no users
steps.expected: A signed-out visitor to /auth/setup lands on Sign in; the setup API answers 409
steps.actual: /auth/setup redirected to /auth/login. The setup API answered 409 "Setup has already been completed.".

steps.action: Setup cannot finish without outbound email: while email is not configured, app pages open the wizard
steps.actual: / -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw); /settings/general -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw); /matters -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw); /settings/email -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw)

steps.action: Welcome step: Skip optional steps while the environment sets SMTP_URL but not SMTP_FROM
steps.expected: Outbound email opens (Step 4 of 8); it says SMTP_FROM is not set; read-only; no Set up later; Continue unavailable
steps.actual: Step 4 of 8: Outbound email at /welcome?step=email. It said "The deployment environment sets SMTP_URL but not SMTP_FROM, so mail cannot be sent. Set SMTP_FROM in the environment." No Set up later, Save relay or Send test email; Continue disabled; onboarding not complete.

steps.action: Finish is refused while outbound email is not configured: open Review and select Finish, then Set up later
steps.expected: Each opens Outbound email; onboarding stays open; the completion API answers 409
steps.actual: Finish on Review opened Step 4 of 8: Outbound email; completed false, review done false. Set up later on Review opened Step 4 of 8: Outbound email; completed false, review done false. the completion API answered 409 "Configure outbound email before finishing instance setup.".

checkMark.className: pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 right-2.5 flex items-center text-status-success-fg
